_comment: Copy to <repo>/.devin/hooks.v1.json. Replace __GATE_DIR__ with the absolute path containing f008_gate.py / ps1_gate.py — either this canon's scripts/ dir or the repo's own vendored .devin/scripts/. The command runs in the session's default shell (Git Bash on Windows workstations): plain `python` resolves to Windows python. On repos whose canonical clone lives inside WSL, call wsl python3 with a WSL-side path instead (see shared_trading_system/.devin/hooks.v1.json).
